files.html: //! profiler_flamegraph - the integrated profiler's flamegraph on the simplest workload there is. //! //! Every frame pretends to be a game frame: it simulates (broadphase, narrowphase, solve), thinks //! (pathfind) and culls, and each step "works" by spinning on the clock for a fixed number of //! milliseconds inside a profiler zone. Once a second one frame also loads a level - a long hitch - and //! the panel, which always shows the WORST frame of the last two seconds, lands on that frame. //! //! The whole integration is three things: a zone at the top of each function (`z.profiler.zone(@src())`, //! named after the function it sits in), a ui window, and `z.profiler_ui.panel(u)` inside it. The engine //! marks the frames itself. The profiler records in `debug` and `release` builds and is compiled out of //! `ship`. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const Ui = z.ui_real.Ui; const Zone = z.profiler.Zone; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); // The pretend workload: how long each step spins, in milliseconds. `solve` and the level load are // sliders instead, so the flamegraph can be watched changing shape. const broadphase_ms: f64 = 0.6; const narrowphase_ms: f64 = 0.9; const pathfind_ms: f64 = 0.8; /// `think`'s own work besides `pathfind`: the flamegraph shows it as the part of `think` with nothing under it. const think_own_ms: f64 = 0.3; const cull_ms: f64 = 0.4; /// One level load a second keeps a hitch inside the profiler's two-second window at all times. const seconds_between_level_loads: f32 = 1.0; const State = struct { ui_host: z.UiHost, font: z.Font, solve_ms: f32 = 1.5, level_load_ms: f32 = 20.0, seconds_since_level_load: f32 = 0, }; fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); s.ui_host.deinit(); } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const font: z.Font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 28); s.* = .{ .ui_host = z.UiHost.init(gpa, font), .font = font }; } /// Burns `ms` milliseconds on the profiler's own clock: the stand-in for real work. The browser's main /// thread cannot block, so a sleep is a spin, and it shows in the flamegraph exactly as work would. A host /// without a clock (host tests) reads 0 forever, so there the spin returns at once rather than never. fn spinMs(ms: f64) void { const start_ms: f64 = z.wgpu.nowMs(); const clock_is_running: bool = start_ms > 0; if (!clock_is_running) { return; } while (z.wgpu.nowMs() - start_ms < ms) {} } fn broadphase() void { const zone: Zone = z.profiler.zone(@src()); defer zone.end(); spinMs(broadphase_ms); } fn narrowphase() void { const zone: Zone = z.profiler.zone(@src()); defer zone.end(); spinMs(narrowphase_ms); } fn solve(solve_ms: f32) void { const zone: Zone = z.profiler.zone(@src()); defer zone.end(); spinMs(solve_ms); } fn simulate(solve_ms: f32) void { const zone: Zone = z.profiler.zone(@src()); defer zone.end(); broadphase(); narrowphase(); solve(solve_ms); } fn pathfind() void { const zone: Zone = z.profiler.zone(@src()); defer zone.end(); spinMs(pathfind_ms); } fn think() void { const zone: Zone = z.profiler.zone(@src()); defer zone.end(); pathfind(); spinMs(think_own_ms); } fn cull() void { const zone: Zone = z.profiler.zone(@src()); defer zone.end(); spinMs(cull_ms); } fn loadLevel(level_load_ms: f32) void { const zone: Zone = z.profiler.zone(@src()); defer zone.end(); spinMs(level_load_ms); } /// The window holding the controls and the profiler's panel. Zoned like the work, so the cost of drawing /// the profiler shows in the profiler. fn drawPanel(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { const zone: Zone = z.profiler.zone(@src()); defer zone.end(); const u: Ui = s.ui_host.begin(f); defer s.ui_host.render(f); const viewport_w: f32 = f.window.widthf(); const viewport_h: f32 = f.window.heightf(); const narrow: bool = Ui.isNarrow(viewport_w); const panel_w: f32 = @min(900.0, viewport_w - 16); const panel_h: f32 = @min(480.0, viewport_h - 16); _ = u.scaleToViewport(panel_w, if (narrow) 30.0 else 48.0); if (u.window("profiler", .{ .initial_pos = .{ 8, 8 }, .initial_size = .{ panel_w, panel_h }, })) |w| { defer w.close(); u.text("once a second a frame loads a level; the panel shows the worst frame of the last 2 s", .{}); _ = u.slider("solve ms", &s.solve_ms, .{ .min = 0, .max = 8 }); _ = u.slider("level load ms", &s.level_load_ms, .{ .min = 0, .max = 40 }); const frozen: bool = z.profiler.isFrozen(); if (u.button(if (frozen) "Live" else "Freeze", .{})) { if (frozen) { z.profiler.unfreeze(); } else { z.profiler.freeze(); } } u.separator(); if (!z.profiler.enabled) { u.text("the profiler is compiled out of ship builds: build with -Dmode=release", .{}); } z.profiler_ui.panel(u); } } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { z.clearViewport(f, .{ .r = 16, .g = 18, .b = 26, .a = 255 }); simulate(s.solve_ms); think(); cull(); s.seconds_since_level_load += f.time.delta_time; const level_load_is_due: bool = s.seconds_since_level_load >= seconds_between_level_loads; if (level_load_is_due) { loadLevel(s.level_load_ms); s.seconds_since_level_load = 0; } drawPanel(f, s); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - profiler flamegraph", .width = 960, .height = 540, .scale_mode = .responsive, .depth_format = null, }, }, .init = initState, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
